test_name: Supply Chain Risk Management SR-4 Evidence Review 098
architecture:
System: Mission-Workflow-098
Environment: Enterprise
Assessment focus: SR-4 (Supply Chain Risk Management).
Observed evidence: A production software package has no verifiable source/build provenance. Its checksum differs from the approved vendor release, and the package was installed from an unofficial mirror on systems that process regulated records.

ground_truth.decision_basis: An unverifiable and mismatched software component from an unofficial source is running in a sensitive production environment.
ground_truth.severity_policy: R4 — The evidence shows a current/confirmed severe condition: active compromise or destructive activity; actual sensitive-data disclosure/loss; actual unauthorized privileged use; direct public/unencrypted exposure of sensitive data or credentials; an internet-facing known exploitable critical flaw without mitigation; or a confirmed integrity-bypassed/tampered production artifact.

provenance: Synthetic holdout-candidate scenario authored independently of the original rubric-aligned 200-case pack.
